answer: Cross-epoch behaviour lock: agents sign a 64-bit vector each epoch; at dawn, validators diff it against the prior 64 and reject calls where cosine drift exceeds 0.12. New IDs have no haven in the ledger, so vectors null out and settlement drops them until 128 compliant epochs pass. An attacker funds 128 gas-signature rounds per sybil (~41k base units at median load), making comet-scale multiplication unprofitable.
